## About the CRM

CRM lets organizers manage all entities (participants, merchandise orders, volunteers, waitlisters, etc.) across events where they have Full Admin access.

Image: Screenshot 2026-05-28 at 2.44.09 PM

To access your CRM, head over to movemint.cc/crm

By default, all entities for Live events will display in the CRM table.

With this tool, you can:

  * View and edit participant information

  * Create and view saved audiences among different entity types

  * Initiate transfers

  * Change sub-events

  * Issue refunds

  * Resend confirmation emails

  * See a timeline of a person across your events

  * Admin add participants, merchandise orders, and external contacts

  * Manage transfers, waitlists, and invitations

  * Export participants as a CSV

  * Check in participants

  * Create Google Sheets based on saved audiences

  * And more!

# Issuing Refunds

Issuing full and partial refunds to participants from your Movemint CRM.

Updated Jul 8, 2026|3 min read

You can issue full or partial refunds to participants directly from the Movemint CRM. Refunds are processed through Stripe and pulled from your connected Stripe account balance. You can refund registration fees and merchandise orders independently or together.

Issuing a refund does not automatically remove the participant from your event - removal is a separate action if needed.

## Before You Can Issue a Refund

  1. Your event must have a connected Stripe account with sufficient balance to cover the refund amount

  2. The participant must have a completed payment - registrations that were free or have no associated Stripe transfer cannot be refunded through this tool

  3. You must have an available unpaid Stripe balance.

## How to Issue a Refund

  1. Go to your Event Admin dashboard and open the CRM

  2. Find the participant you want to refund

  3. Open their Action menu and select Refund Participant

Image: refund
  4. A panel will open showing:

     * Total Account Balance - your current Stripe account balance

     * Gross Registration - the original amount the participant paid

     * Amount remaining to refund - the maximum refundable amount (original payment minus any refunds already issued)

Image: refund-participant-panel
  5. Enter the Refund Amount for the registration fee

  6. If the participant purchased merchandise, any refundable merchandise orders will appear as checkboxes - select the ones you want to refund

  7. Click Process Refund

## How It Works

✅ Partial refunds are supported.

You can refund any amount up to the remaining refundable balance. The system tracks how much has already been refunded per transaction, so you cannot accidentally over-refund.

✅ Merchandise refunds are separate line items.

When a participant has merchandise orders on the same checkout, you can refund them individually by checking the relevant items. You can also refund merchandise orders on their own without touching the registration fee.

✅ Taxes are handled automatically.

When a refund is processed, the corresponding tax amounts are reversed through Avalara automatically - you do not need to manage tax adjustments separately.

⚠️ The registration is not cancelled.

Issuing a refund through this panel returns money to the participant but leaves their registration active. If you want to remove them from the event, you will need to do so separately from the participant management tools.

⚠️ The refund comes from your Stripe balance.

Stripe pulls the refund amount from your connected account's available balance. If your balance is insufficient, the refund will fail - you would need to ensure your account has adequate funds before proceeding.

## Important Notes

👉 You can only refund what was paid. The maximum refund amount is capped at the original payment minus any amounts already refunded

👉 Refunds cannot be reversed once processed - double-check the amount before confirming

👉 Service fees are not refunded by default. Movemint pays processing fees regardless. If you feel a service fee refund is needed in addition to the registration refund due to a technical issue, contact Movemint support.

👉 Free registrations cannot be refunded through this tool since there is no associated Stripe payment to reverse

## Other Options

Rather than a refund, you might consider offering the following:

  * Registration deferral

  * Credit or discount that can be applied to another event

  * Bib transfer

  * Switch to a different distance

## Adding funds to your Stripe balance

If there is insufficient funds due to sales being paid out, here are some steps to create/add to a payment account balance.

  1. Log into Stripe with your email connected to your Movemint account.

  2. Head to Balances.

  3. Click on the Add to Balances button to add funds.

  4. Select the Refunds & Disputes option.

Image
  5. Set the amount for funds to be added.

  6. Add funds via Wire Transfer or ACH Credit.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Movemint Features

How do I upload results?

Movemint has multiple ways of uploading results to an event. Results can be uploaded to Movemint using CSV mapping, PDF, or synced with our RACE RESULT integration.

To learn more about uploading results, seeResults on Movemint.

How do virtual events work?

In virtual events, organizers select a date range and desired Strava segments. Participants complete these segments, and Movemint generates leaderboards for best efforts (lowest time) and most efforts. Multiple segments and sport types can be combined.

Virtual events are currently in beta. Learn more on Virtual Leaderboards.

Can I add other admins?

Yes, organizers can add multiple event admins, including timers, charity partners, or team members.

To learn more about different admin roles for your event, see Admin Roles.

Can I send donations directly to my donations partners?

Yes, organizers can assign a payment account to each donation category, directing funds to the respective organization. Charity partners added as admins can input their bank information into a payment account.

To learn more about donations on Movemint, see Collecting Donations.

To learn more about assigning charity partners added as admins, see Admin Roles.

Can I ask custom questions during registration?

Yes, organizers can include multiple custom questions, allowing participants to provide free-form answers or select from predefined options.

To learn more about custom questions during registration, see Conditional Questions.

Can I sell merchandise?

Yes, Movemint supports merchandise sales, such as t-shirts and hoodies. Merchandise can be configured with single or multiple options (e.g., sizes).

To learn more about merchandise, seeMerchandise.

How do payouts work?

Movemint uses Stripe for payment processing and payouts. After creating the first event, organizers are directed to Stripe to set up payouts, which can be configured to a bank account, card, etc. By default, registration fees are paid out every other day.

To learn about about Financials on Movemint, seeFinancials.

How do emails work?

Upon creating an event, organizers gain access to Movemint's email marketing tool, allowing unlimited emails for free. Emails can be sent immediately or scheduled, targeting current participants or specific audiences (e.g., previous year's participants not yet registered).

To learn more about communications on Movemint, see the following Movemint Docs: SMS Messaging, Sending Emails, and Automating Emails.

How do waivers work?

During registration, participants must agree to Movemint's default waiver. Organizers can add their own waiver, requiring participants to agree to both. Waivers can also be applied to volunteers.

To learn more about waivers, see Creating Waivers.

How do Strava course maps work?

Movemint integrates with Strava, allowing organizers to attach Strava routes as course maps. After event creation, organizers can connect their Strava account, import routes, and attach them to the event. Participants can then access these routes for training and navigation.

To learn more, see Strava Integration.

Can I import existing customer and event data?

Yes, Movemint assists with importing existing customer and event data.

To learn more, see Migrate participants.

For help in getting this set up, contact support@movemint.cc.

Can I allow athletes to transfer their registration to another athlete?

Yes you can.

To learn more about how to open up permissions for participants in your event to transfer their registration to another athlete, see Enabling bib transfers.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Transfer Your Registration

Transfer your registration to your profile

Updated Aug 15, 2026|2 min read

Changed your mind about an event or unable to make it? If the organizer allows transfers, you can transfer your bib to someone else.

You Need an Account to Transfer Your Registration: To transfer your registration, you must have a Movemint account. If you registered for the event before creating an account, no problem - you can create one anytime. Just add your event to your new account using your confirmation number (here's how), then follow the transfer steps.

### Transfers Must Be Enabled by the Organizer

Before you can transfer your registration, the event organizer must have enabled transfers for their event. If you don't see the "Transfer to friend" option, it means either:

  * The organizer hasn't enabled transfers

  * The transfer deadline has passed

  * You purchased a series pass

If transfers aren't available or you purchased a series pass, reach out to the organizer directly to ask about your options.

### How Transfers Work

When you transfer your registration:

  * Your spot goes to the other person

  * They'll fill in their own information

  * Any transfer fees set by the organizer are their responsibility (not yours)

  * No money exchanges directly between you and them

### If You're Transferring Your Registration

Open your Athlete Profile

Login to Movemint and go to your Athlete Profile and find the event you want to change.

Click 'Manage Registration'

Click the 'Manage Registration' button found on the event card.

Click 'Transfer to a friend' (See Image Below)

If transfers are enabled, click the 'Transfer to a friend' button.

Enter their Email Address

Enter the email address of the friend you are transferring to.

Click 'Submit'

After clicking submit your should see a confirmation "A transfer invitation has been sent to [yourfriendsemail@gmail.com] They'll receive an email to claim your spot."

You're Done!

Image: Transfer to a friend

### Canceling a Transfer

Want to cancel before they accept? No problem, in the same place you initiated the transfer you will now see the option to cancel the pending transfer.

## FAQ

Is there a fee to host my event?

No. Creating and hosting an event on Movemint is always free.

Do I keep my registration revenue?

Yes. By default, participants pay the transaction fee, so you receive 100% of your listed registration price. You can also choose to absorb some or all of the fee if you prefer.

Can I use my own payment processor?

Movemint uses Stripe to securely process payments, supporting 100+ currencies and global payouts.

Are there contracts?

No long-term contracts are required for standard events. Enterprise partnerships may include custom agreements.

Do you offer nonprofit pricing?

Contact us for more information.

Can I pay for some or all of the service fee?

# Series Passes

Bundle Events on Movemint

Updated Oct 16, 2026|4 min read

Copy page

A series groups several of your events under one page, such as a summer race series or a cyclocross season. A series pass is a single purchase that registers a participant for a set of sub-events across those events. One checkout covers the whole season instead of one registration per race.

Use a series pass when you want to:

  * Sell a season or bundle at one price, often lower than buying each race separately.

  * Offer different bundles, such as a full-series pass and a 3-race pass.

  * Track participants across the whole series, not just one race.

Each event in a pass is still its own Movemint event, with its own sub-events, check-in and results. The pass just registers people into them together.

## Setting up a series and its pass

  1. Create the events first. Each race in the series needs to exist as a Movemint event, with the sub-events the pass should cover (for example, the 5K at each race). See How to Create an Event.

  2. Create the series. From your organizer dashboard, open the Series tab and create a new series. Enter its name, description, and Series Start Date and Series End Date.

  3. Open the series admin and go to Series Passes.

  4. Click Create New Series Pass and fill in:

     * Pass Name and Description: what buyers see, such as "Full Season Pass".

     * Sub-events: search and select the sub-event at each race this pass registers people for.

     * Price: one or more price tiers. Give a tier an end date to run early-bird pricing. Leave the end date empty for a price that runs until registration closes.

     * Max Participants: a cap on passes sold. Leave empty for unlimited.

     * Registration Open Date and Registration Close Date, with the timezone.

  5. Click Create Pass. Repeat for each bundle you want to offer.

  6. Preview it. Open the series page and check each pass shows the right races and price.

Once anyone has bought a pass, its sub-events are locked so existing holders' registrations stay valid. You can still change its name, description, dates, cap and prices.

## How it works for participants

  1. They find the pass. Passes are listed on the series page. Each event included in a pass also shows it on its own event page, so someone browsing one race can see the season option.

  2. They register once. They pick a pass, fill in their details, answer any registration questions for the events in the pass, and add any optional add-ons.

  3. They pay in one checkout. Discount codes set up for the series work here too.

  4. They're registered for every race in the pass. They appear as a participant in each event's covered sub-event, so they show in that event's start list, check-in and results like anyone else.

They don't need to register again for each race. Their confirmation covers the whole pass.

## Managing passes and pass holders

--- | --- | ---

See who bought  | Series admin → Participants  | Every pass holder, with an export to CSV
Move someone to a different pass  | Participants → transfer  | Switches them to the other pass's races. Use it for upgrades or downgrades
Remove a pass holder  | Participants → remove  | Takes them off the series. Removing someone does not refund them. Issue any refund separately
Edit a pass  | Series Passes → edit  | Prices, dates and cap can always change. Sub-events lock once anyone has bought
Add series admins  | Series admin → Admins  | Invite by email. The owner can transfer ownership to an admin who has accepted

A series can also be added to your group, so it appears on your organization's group page.

## About Movemint

What is Movemint?

Movemint is a platform designed for athletic events, simplifying the management of event registrations, communication, and results for organizers. It offers features such as waiver signing, donation and merchandise support, volunteer management, and robust communications and marketing tools.

What kind of events does Movemint support?

Movemint supports a wide range of athletic events, including running races, bike races, walk-a-thons, gran fondos, group rides, fundraisers, and more, accommodating events with participants ranging from 10 to over 10,000.

Does Movemint support free and paid events?

Yes, when creating an event on Movemint, organizers can create multiple categories (e.g., 10k, kids race), assigning a price to each or leaving it blank for free categories.

How much does Movemint cost?

Movemint is free for event organizers, generating revenue through a low processing fee added to paid checkouts.

To learn more about our pricing, see Event hosting cost.

Can Movemint help me set up my event?

Yes, Movemint offers assistance with event setup.

Contact us at support@movemint.cc.

Can I collect donations?

Yes, during event creation or editing, organizers can set up donations, adding multiple organizations. Participants are prompted to select a donation amount during checkout but can opt out. This opt-out approach encourages more donations.

To learn more about fundraising on Movemint, see Collecting Donations.

Does Movemint collect and remit sales tax?

Yes, Movemint collects and remits sales tax for all events by default.

To learn more about Movemint sales tax policies, see Sales tax policies.

Can I manage volunteers on Movemint?

Yes, organizers can create multiple volunteer categories, assigning names, descriptions, and volunteer limits to each (e.g., 3 people at the registration tent from 9 am to noon).

To learn more about volunteers on Movemint, see Volunteer Categories.

How does Movemint work with timers?

Timers can export participant data from Movemint into their scoring software or sync with RACE RESULT through our integration.

Please contact rebecca@movemint.cc to learn more.

## Movemint Features

How do I upload results?

Movemint has multiple ways of uploading results to an event. Results can be uploaded to Movemint using CSV mapping, PDF, or synced with our RACE RESULT integration.

To learn more about uploading results, seeResults on Movemint.

How do virtual events work?

In virtual events, organizers select a date range and desired Strava segments. Participants complete these segments, and Movemint generates leaderboards for best efforts (lowest time) and most efforts. Multiple segments and sport types can be combined.

Virtual events are currently in beta. Learn more on Virtual Leaderboards.

Can I add other admins?

Yes, organizers can add multiple event admins, including timers, charity partners, or team members.

To learn more about different admin roles for your event, see Admin Roles.

Can I send donations directly to my donations partners?

Yes, organizers can assign a payment account to each donation category, directing funds to the respective organization. Charity partners added as admins can input their bank information into a payment account.

To learn more about donations on Movemint, see Collecting Donations.

To learn more about assigning charity partners added as admins, see Admin Roles.

Can I ask custom questions during registration?

Yes, organizers can include multiple custom questions, allowing participants to provide free-form answers or select from predefined options.

To learn more about custom questions during registration, see Conditional Questions.

Can I sell merchandise?

Yes, Movemint supports merchandise sales, such as t-shirts and hoodies. Merchandise can be configured with single or multiple options (e.g., sizes).

To learn more about merchandise, seeMerchandise.

How do payouts work?

Movemint uses Stripe for payment processing and payouts. After creating the first event, organizers are directed to Stripe to set up payouts, which can be configured to a bank account, card, etc. By default, registration fees are paid out every other day.

To learn about about Financials on Movemint, seeFinancials.

How do emails work?

Upon creating an event, organizers gain access to Movemint's email marketing tool, allowing unlimited emails for free. Emails can be sent immediately or scheduled, targeting current participants or specific audiences (e.g., previous year's participants not yet registered).

To learn more about communications on Movemint, see the following Movemint Docs: SMS Messaging, Sending Emails, and Automating Emails.

How do waivers work?

During registration, participants must agree to Movemint's default waiver. Organizers can add their own waiver, requiring participants to agree to both. Waivers can also be applied to volunteers.

To learn more about waivers, see Creating Waivers.

How do Strava course maps work?

Movemint integrates with Strava, allowing organizers to attach Strava routes as course maps. After event creation, organizers can connect their Strava account, import routes, and attach them to the event. Participants can then access these routes for training and navigation.

To learn more, see Strava Integration.

Can I import existing customer and event data?

Yes, Movemint assists with importing existing customer and event data.

To learn more, see Migrate participants.

For help in getting this set up, contact support@movemint.cc.

Can I allow athletes to transfer their registration to another athlete?

Yes you can.

# Series Passes

Bundle Events on Movemint

Updated Oct 16, 2026|4 min read

Copy page

A series groups several of your events under one page, such as a summer race series or a cyclocross season. A series pass is a single purchase that registers a participant for a set of sub-events across those events. One checkout covers the whole season instead of one registration per race.

Use a series pass when you want to:

  * Sell a season or bundle at one price, often lower than buying each race separately.

  * Offer different bundles, such as a full-series pass and a 3-race pass.

  * Track participants across the whole series, not just one race.

Each event in a pass is still its own Movemint event, with its own sub-events, check-in and results. The pass just registers people into them together.

## Setting up a series and its pass

  1. Create the events first. Each race in the series needs to exist as a Movemint event, with the sub-events the pass should cover (for example, the 5K at each race). See How to Create an Event.

  2. Create the series. From your organizer dashboard, open the Series tab and create a new series. Enter its name, description, and Series Start Date and Series End Date.

  3. Open the series admin and go to Series Passes.

  4. Click Create New Series Pass and fill in:

     * Pass Name and Description: what buyers see, such as "Full Season Pass".

     * Sub-events: search and select the sub-event at each race this pass registers people for.

     * Price: one or more price tiers. Give a tier an end date to run early-bird pricing. Leave the end date empty for a price that runs until registration closes.

     * Max Participants: a cap on passes sold. Leave empty for unlimited.

     * Registration Open Date and Registration Close Date, with the timezone.

  5. Click Create Pass. Repeat for each bundle you want to offer.

  6. Preview it. Open the series page and check each pass shows the right races and price.

Once anyone has bought a pass, its sub-events are locked so existing holders' registrations stay valid. You can still change its name, description, dates, cap and prices.

## How it works for participants

  1. They find the pass. Passes are listed on the series page. Each event included in a pass also shows it on its own event page, so someone browsing one race can see the season option.

  2. They register once. They pick a pass, fill in their details, answer any registration questions for the events in the pass, and add any optional add-ons.

  3. They pay in one checkout. Discount codes set up for the series work here too.

  4. They're registered for every race in the pass. They appear as a participant in each event's covered sub-event, so they show in that event's start list, check-in and results like anyone else.

They don't need to register again for each race. Their confirmation covers the whole pass.

# How Refund Protection Works

How it works and how to activate it.

Updated Oct 17, 2026|4 min read

Copy page

Refund protection (called registration protection in Movemint) is an optional add-on participants can buy at checkout. If something unexpected stops them from attending, such as an injury, illness, travel problem or work conflict, they can get a full refund of their registration.

For organizers, it costs nothing and handles refund requests for you:

  * You keep your payout. Approved refunds are paid by Movemint, not taken back from you.

  * You don't handle claims. Movemint reviews every request and talks to the participant directly.

  * You can resell the spot. When a claim is paid, that participant's entry is removed from your event.

  * More sign-ups. People on the fence are more likely to register when they know they're covered.

It's a refund program, not insurance. It's available on paid events.

## How it works for participants

  1. They're offered it at checkout. A step called Add registration protection shows the price for their cart and links to the full program details. They choose yes or no.

  2. They get a confirmation email with a link to manage their protection.

  3. They can change their mind. Within 7 days of purchase, they can cancel the protection from that link and get its cost back.

  4. If they can't attend, they file a claim. From the same link, they pick the person it's for, choose a covered reason, add details, and upload documents such as a doctor's note.

  5. Movemint reviews it and replies by email, asking for more information if needed.

  6. Approved claims are refunded. The registration cost goes back to their original payment method, and their entry is removed from the event.

Covered reasons include:

Category

Examples

Sickness, injury, death

Serious illness or injury to them or a companion; serious illness of an immediate family member; a death in the family; pregnancy complications

Weather and disasters

Severe weather or an official weather emergency that stops them reaching the event

Getting there

A traffic accident, car breakdown or car theft within 48 hours; a delayed travel carrier

Open Table

Not covered: changes of plans, anything foreseeable when they bought it, or the event being canceled or postponed by the organizer. The full list is on the public program details page.

Deadlines: they should notify Movemint within 30 days of the reason arising, and send proof within 90 days. Approved refunds are paid within 30 days of receiving proof.

## Turning it on

Refund protection is on by default for new events. To check or change it:

  1. Open your event admin and go to Event Page → Details.

  2. Scroll to Participant Registration Protection. This section only appears on paid events.

  3. Use the Offer registration protection switch. On means participants see the offer at checkout. Off shows a warning: Without registration protection, participants cannot receive refunds if they need to cancel their registration.

  4. Save the page.

The change applies to new registrations from then on. To see what participants will see, use View Event and go through checkout: the protection step appears after the registration details.

No. Movemint pays the refund, and you keep everything you were paid for that registration.

## About Movemint

What is Movemint?

Movemint is a platform designed for athletic events, simplifying the management of event registrations, communication, and results for organizers. It offers features such as waiver signing, donation and merchandise support, volunteer management, and robust communications and marketing tools.

What kind of events does Movemint support?

Movemint supports a wide range of athletic events, including running races, bike races, walk-a-thons, gran fondos, group rides, fundraisers, and more, accommodating events with participants ranging from 10 to over 10,000.

Does Movemint support free and paid events?

Yes, when creating an event on Movemint, organizers can create multiple categories (e.g., 10k, kids race), assigning a price to each or leaving it blank for free categories.

How much does Movemint cost?

Movemint is free for event organizers, generating revenue through a low processing fee added to paid checkouts.

To learn more about our pricing, see Event hosting cost.

Can Movemint help me set up my event?

Yes, Movemint offers assistance with event setup.

Contact us at support@movemint.cc.

Can I collect donations?

Yes, during event creation or editing, organizers can set up donations, adding multiple organizations. Participants are prompted to select a donation amount during checkout but can opt out. This opt-out approach encourages more donations.

To learn more about fundraising on Movemint, see Collecting Donations.

Does Movemint collect and remit sales tax?

Yes, Movemint collects and remits sales tax for all events by default.

To learn more about Movemint sales tax policies, see Sales tax policies.

Can I manage volunteers on Movemint?

Yes, organizers can create multiple volunteer categories, assigning names, descriptions, and volunteer limits to each (e.g., 3 people at the registration tent from 9 am to noon).

To learn more about volunteers on Movemint, see Volunteer Categories.

How does Movemint work with timers?

Timers can export participant data from Movemint into their scoring software or sync with RACE RESULT through our integration.

Please contact rebecca@movemint.cc to learn more.

## Movemint Features

How do I upload results?

Movemint has multiple ways of uploading results to an event. Results can be uploaded to Movemint using CSV mapping, PDF, or synced with our RACE RESULT integration.

To learn more about uploading results, seeResults on Movemint.

How do virtual events work?

In virtual events, organizers select a date range and desired Strava segments. Participants complete these segments, and Movemint generates leaderboards for best efforts (lowest time) and most efforts. Multiple segments and sport types can be combined.

Virtual events are currently in beta. Learn more on Virtual Leaderboards.

Can I add other admins?

Yes, organizers can add multiple event admins, including timers, charity partners, or team members.

To learn more about different admin roles for your event, see Admin Roles.

Can I send donations directly to my donations partners?

Yes, organizers can assign a payment account to each donation category, directing funds to the respective organization. Charity partners added as admins can input their bank information into a payment account.

To learn more about donations on Movemint, see Collecting Donations.

To learn more about assigning charity partners added as admins, see Admin Roles.

Can I ask custom questions during registration?

Yes, organizers can include multiple custom questions, allowing participants to provide free-form answers or select from predefined options.

To learn more about custom questions during registration, see Conditional Questions.

Can I sell merchandise?

Yes, Movemint supports merchandise sales, such as t-shirts and hoodies. Merchandise can be configured with single or multiple options (e.g., sizes).

To learn more about merchandise, seeMerchandise.

How do payouts work?

Movemint uses Stripe for payment processing and payouts. After creating the first event, organizers are directed to Stripe to set up payouts, which can be configured to a bank account, card, etc. By default, registration fees are paid out every other day.

Upon creating an event, organizers gain access to Movemint's email marketing tool, allowing unlimited emails for free. Emails can be sent immediately or scheduled, targeting current participants or specific audiences (e.g., previous year's participants not yet registered).

To learn more about communications on Movemint, see the following Movemint Docs: SMS Messaging, Sending Emails, and Automating Emails.

How do waivers work?

During registration, participants must agree to Movemint's default waiver. Organizers can add their own waiver, requiring participants to agree to both. Waivers can also be applied to volunteers.

To learn more about waivers, see Creating Waivers.

How do Strava course maps work?

Movemint integrates with Strava, allowing organizers to attach Strava routes as course maps. After event creation, organizers can connect their Strava account, import routes, and attach them to the event. Participants can then access these routes for training and navigation.

To learn more, see Strava Integration.

Can I import existing customer and event data?

Yes, Movemint assists with importing existing customer and event data.

To learn more, see Migrate participants.

For help in getting this set up, contact support@movemint.cc.

Can I allow athletes to transfer their registration to another athlete?

Yes you can.

Manage finances for your events on Movemint. Organizers can see event revenue, payout reports, invoices, manage Payment Accounts and more.

Image

* * *

### Payment Accounts

A Payment Account on Movemint is where your event's registration fees and/or donations live. It's powered by Stripe, and once connected, it allows organizers to receive payouts directly to your bank account, track transactions, and more.

#### How to Create a Payment Account

  1. Head over to Financials in your Organizer Dashboard

  2. Click Create Payment Account. To add an additional payment account, click +Add Account in thePayment Account dropdown.

Image
  3. Type in a name for the Payment Account.

Image
  4. Proceed in Stripe to create the Payment Account.

Image

Information needed to set up include:

     * Professional details (website, business category, etc.)

     * Public details (customer support, etc.)

     * Personal details

     * Payout details (bank account to be receiving funds)

* * *

### Events

In the Events tab, organizers can see revenue from their event, manage the payment account per event, download the full event payout, and see the services fees set per event.

Image

* * *

### Payouts

In the Payouts tab, organizers can see and download each payout, add a new payout, and schedule payouts.

#### How to Download a Payout

  1. Head over to the Payouts tab from financials.

  2. Locate the payout you would like to download.

  3. Click the download icon.

#### How to Add a New Payout

  1. Head over to the Payouts tab from financials.

  2. Click the New Payout button.

  3. Input the description and amount.

  4. Click Save.

#### How to Schedule Payouts

Set a schedule to automatically move revenue from your payments balance into your bank account.

  1. Head over to the Payouts tab from financials.

  2. Click Payout Schedule next to the New Payout button.

  3. Select if you would like to be paid out automatically or manually.

Image
     * Automatic: Organizers can be paid out by daily, weekly, or monthly. If weekly or monthly, you must specific the weekday or day of the month, respectively.

     * Maunal: You will no longer be able to see which transactions are bundled in a payout.

  4. Click Save.

* * *

### Account Settings

In the Account Settings tab, organizers can create new payment accounts, rename existing ones, see payment account status, and manage payment accounts on Stripe.
